bio: Enjoy the Afternoon Tea experience at Alma Lodge Hotel. Located in Stockport, this restaurant offers a comfortable and relaxing space for everyone to experience.  Afternoon Tea is served in the spacious Henderson's restaurant, located on the elevated ground floor of the hotel. The area is easily accessible to all, allowing guests to enjoy Afternoon Tea with friends and loved ones.  The menu features a selection of freshly made sandwiches, scones with clotted cream, and a variety of delicious cakes. Guests can also choose to upgrade to a glass of Prosecco and chocolate dipped strawberries for a real sense of luxury.  Alma Lodge Hotel is in Stockport, Manchester, and is just a stone's throw away from Davenport and Stockport train station.  Please note Afternoon Tea bookings require at least 24 hours' notice, and dietary requirements can be catered for with advance notice.
